paragraphs.original: A list of $483$ classes exceeds what the target hardware can carry. A nano-scale detector in the $1$--$3\,\mathrm{M}$-parameter range spreads its discriminative capacity too thinly once the label space grows beyond roughly $200$--$300$ fine-grained classes, which fixed an approximate ceiling of $200$--$250$ classes. Birds, bats and marine mammals other than pinnipeds were then excluded outright, and domestic animals deliberately kept.

paragraphs.section: Candidate Data Sources and Licensing Assessment
paragraphs.original: Source selection also fixed how far each source's own species labels can be trusted, an axis the curation pipeline depends on. \textit{iNaturalist}, \textit{GBIF} and Wikipedia-derived material are label-trusted, since their labels carry an identifiable contributor and community verification. Open Images and the stock-image source are unverified, their labels being colloquial or of unknown provenance. An unverified source contributes to a class's usable pool only where an independent classifier corroborates the label, whereas a trusted source contributes on passing the quality gates alone (\Cref{sec:data_quality_and_curation}).

paragraphs.section: Sourcing Execution and the LILA BC Rejection
paragraphs.original: Three large camera-trap archives under a commercially compatible license were scanned against the $225$-class taxonomy and rejected \cite{LILABCLabeled}. No images from them entered the corpus.

paragraphs.section: A Divergence Between the Stated and Implemented License Policy
paragraphs.original: An audit found that the implemented license allow-list admits ShareAlike variants, and NoDerivatives on the COCO downloads, contrary to the policy stated above. Of the $11{,}066$ Wikimedia images in the final splits, $6{,}222$ carry a ShareAlike license. Every model reported in \Cref{chapter:results} was therefore trained and evaluated on a corpus containing imagery the policy excludes, and the finding is carried forward as a named limitation (\Cref{sec:limitations}).

This pool still mixes sources of very different reliability, which is what \Cref{sec:data_quality_and_curation} addresses.
